## Code Review Summary
Spec mode, initial pass on r4-repair content (round 4). Candidate `ticket05-spec-r5.md` sha256 `8bbb0907…e64f`. 1 HIGH, 4 MEDIUM, 3 LOW.

### Issues
[HIGH][statement-contradiction] F-A direct carrier keeps unprojected data while disclosing applied=true
Anchor: spec:50 (C4b ii), :61 (AC1 N11/F1), :12 (R2); `direct_execution.go:53,60-64`. conf:H
E3 gives docker_proxy `output_schema {result:string}` + x-fastmcp-wrap-result; E14 copies `upstream.StructuredContent` into the direct result. Direct `docker_proxy /containers/json` default ⇒ SC `{"result":"<full list>"}`; C4b(ii)/AC1(N11) keep it verbatim beside `mcp_bridge_projection{applied:true}`, while R2/AC1(F1) forbid any unprojected carrier when applied. The AC oracle would pin the violation.
Fix: rewrite the payload-bearing member to the projected list (carrier completeness) or SKIP with `structured_content_not_mirrorable`; restrict "verbatim" to non-payload members; add the wrapper fixture.

[MEDIUM][r-ac-coverage-gap] F-B normative D-table absent; aggregate reason unbound
Anchor: spec:45, :66 (AC6 d), T1:78; r3:44-63. conf:H
r3's 13 rows carried per-row reasons (aggregate all-missing → `item_shape_unexpected`; default-mode error → no disclosure). r4/r5 compress them to one sentence, so the closed 12-value enum has no bound default-miss value: AC6(d)'s "specific reason" cannot fail (T3 union accepts any value) and T1 implements a table the candidate lacks.
Fix: reinstate r3's table plus N9/N10/C4b rows with explicit reasons; name the aggregate reason in AC6(d)/§7.

[MEDIUM][statement-contradiction] F-C §4 forbids skip disclosures
Anchor: spec:44 vs :16 (R6), :66 (AC6 a'/d). conf:H
Rule: SKIP → "no disclosure member added"; required: `full_requested`/`upstream_error` skips disclose `applied:false`+reason, and AC6(d) demands a disclosed `applied:false` for the direct reserved-key collision that C4b(iii) forbids payload-disclosing.
Fix: scope the clause to upstream result bytes/value; state each row's channel (payload vs log-only) per path.

[MEDIUM][r-ac-coverage-gap] F-D config-feasibility regression unstated
Anchor: spec:82-83 (T3), :104 (§8); `config/bounds.go:348-363`. conf:H
The maximal disclosure (~600 B: 512 B array + keys) added to the maximal sets raises the minimum admissible `preview_ceiling_bytes` from ≈730 to ≈1352 (`maximalPreviewMetadata` ≈212 B + 512 + 6). Configs in that range validate today and fail after; no AC covers it; §8 claims no config change.
Fix: state the new minimum, assert the default still validates, add an existing-bounds oracle, document the consequence.

[MEDIUM][stale-citation] F-E N8 reopened — citation repair incomplete
Anchor: E14:27 (:60/:69-73), T2:77, E12:25 (:188), E13:26 (:219, :200-216). conf:H
Actual `direct_execution.go`: decode :53, result :60-64, bounded call :65 — T2's "between :60 and :69-73" lands after construction. `terminalSizingMetadata` is :187; `retainedEnvelopeHeadroom` :221; `boundedResultPrefix` 197-228; E16's `observe.RecordRetentionRejection` is a `(*Metrics)` method.
Fix: correct offsets; verify every offset, not only the first anchor per citation.

### Closure
Closed: N9 (single outcome; `fields:[]` rejects; `{}`/`full:false` absent; full+fields conflict); N10 (AC6(e)); N12 (5-arg call `bounded_delivery_test.go:353`; keyed `resultEntry`; variadic `commit`); N13 count; AC1–AC7 verbatim vs issue-119; write set 3 NEW + 13 MODIFIED = T1–T3 = state effects; ticket-01 arity/seams.
Residual: N11 (F-A); N13 totality (F-B); N8 (F-E); N2 oracle F-F ("measured+512−codeWidth+6<1536" matches neither `retainedResultEnvelopeFits` base+512+6≤ceiling nor `boundedResultPrefix` base+512−codeWidth<ceiling; conservative at empty code; the 512 cap leaves ≈190 B preview budget, so substance holds).
LOW: F-G "pinned" undefined (both entries `pinned:false`; direct path = config pin or `expose_tools` tool); F-H `projection` extracted without path discrimination; state CR1/CT1 `blockedBy []` vs ledger deps.

### Positive
512 cap computed from both bounds; partitions single-outcome; enum bounded; arity preserved; ACs verbatim.

Round 4: advisory for admission under W09; technical verdict stands.

### Recommendation
REQUEST CHANGES
